cards.note: no custom spill-policy configuration anywhere: the bundle patch inserts only the unanchored skill-hub row and the tree has no maxInlineBytes/spill key to re-express

informational: dependency resolution pulls the vendored set (lockfile resolves @deepseek-ai/cordis 4.0.5-alpha.2 and @deepseek-ai/schemastery 3.18.5-alpha.2 inside the declared ~4.0.5-alpha.1 / ~3.18.5-alpha.1 same-minor ranges); no plugin action

install-UX only: the plugin is added with `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-skill-hub`, ships no registry/source configuration (no .npmrc) and carries no workaround the auto-selected registry would retire
informational for client plugins: lib/client.js is the served artifact, so every edit was followed by a rebuild and a host restart before the cold-boot check; no code action

every @deepseek-ai/dsh-* peer carries one explicit union range with a branch per corridor prerelease tuple (>=0.1.7-alpha.1 <0.3.0-0 || >=0.2.0-rc.1 <0.3.0-0 || >=0.2.1-alpha.2 <0.3.0-0): npm compares a prerelease only inside its own major.minor.patch, so the first branch alone admits no 0.2.1 prerelease and refused the 0.2.1-alpha.2 target; dev cohort pinned to 0.2.1-alpha.2
the client half registers settings/plugins slots and wraps the /skill trigger source only; it has no tool.call.toolview entry and never reads RunningToolCall/ToolCallBlock
no Chat feature half: the plugin implements no ConversationNodeDefinition and never touches UiConversation.events
the plugin reads and writes only its own skill-hub config form; it neither reads nor writes the chat transcriptView setting
informational: install is a plain npm add into the profile, not a GitHub-spec install; no install automation or failure-interpretation code lives in this repo

peer ranges carry a >=0.2.0-rc.1 <0.3.0-0 branch so the RC prereleases resolve under npm's in-tuple rule as well as the host's includePrerelease check, and a >=0.2.1-alpha.2 branch so the 0.2.1-alpha.2 target is admitted (a ^0.2.0 floor would refuse the RC and the 0.1.7 corridor); devDependencies and the lockfile were moved to the 0.2.1-alpha.2 cohort and the plugin boots on the installed 0.2.1-alpha.2 host
no Chat settings schema consumer and no hard-coded transcript fallback: the plugin's views derive from its own catalog/routes
the bundle patch inserts one unanchored `skill-hub` row and depends on no schedule/time-context/ui-schedule service, so the optional schedule bundle moving out of web-app changes nothing
no telemetry row is mirrored or inserted in the same composition and no id collides with the new otel/analytics rows (only skill-hub is added)
the browser half never forks a Session (no ISessions/useSessions usage), so the optional onCreated callback has no call site to update
no native-command/reveal/open-in-app call and no local visibility hotfix: the host half uses only ctx.webServer.register, ctx.skills and ctx.systemPrompt
